rows.item: Dark mode is supported or explicitly handled.
rows.expected: With prefers-color-scheme: dark, the UI provides a deliberate dark presentation.
rows.whyAiMissed: The initial prompt focused on the happy-path purchase flow and did not request color-scheme variants.
rows.notes: Dark preference does not produce an intentional dark theme.

rows.item: RTL layout is supported without broken alignment.
rows.expected: When direction is RTL, controls remain readable and intentionally ordered.
rows.whyAiMissed: The AI assumed Vietnamese left-to-right layout and did not challenge the locale direction assumption.
rows.notes: The app has no RTL locale/direction support; forcing dir changes text direction without an intentional layout.

rows.item: Content reflows at a 320 CSS-pixel viewport without two-dimensional scrolling.
rows.expected: Core content remains operable without horizontal overflow at the WCAG reflow width.
rows.whyAiMissed: The initial AI list considered ordinary breakpoints but omitted low-vision reflow at the WCAG reference width.
rows.notes: At 320 CSS pixels the cart requires horizontal scrolling.

rows.item: Interactive targets meet the WCAG 2.2 minimum size.
rows.expected: Non-exempt mobile targets are at least 24 by 24 CSS pixels.
rows.whyAiMissed: The AI described responsiveness visually but did not quantify target-size accessibility.

rows.item: Dynamic feedback is announced to assistive technology.
rows.expected: Add-to-cart and coupon messages use role=status/alert or aria-live.
rows.whyAiMissed: The AI checked visible feedback but overlooked non-visual announcement semantics.
rows.notes: Dynamic add/coupon feedback has no role=status/alert or aria-live.

rows.item: Search text is rendered safely as text.
rows.expected: Markup entered in search does not create DOM elements or execute handlers.
rows.whyAiMissed: The initial prompt framed the task as GUI testing, so the AI omitted a UI injection probe tied to rendered feedback.
rows.notes: Search feedback renders user input through dangerouslySetInnerHTML.

rows.item: A network failure produces a friendly recovery state.
rows.expected: Failed product requests show a user-facing error and retry guidance.
rows.whyAiMissed: The AI tested ordinary states but did not introduce a network fault.
rows.notes: A failed product request leaves an unexplained empty area.

rows.item: A missing product produces a friendly not-found state.
rows.expected: Missing product message avoids internal/debug wording and offers recovery.
rows.whyAiMissed: The AI used seeded product IDs and did not explore a non-existent resource.
rows.actual: main="Sản phẩm không tồn tại (Lỗi trắng trang do data rỗng)"
rows.notes: Missing-product state exposes debug-like wording and no recovery action.

rows.item: Cart state survives an accidental page refresh.
rows.expected: Items remain available after reload or the limitation is clearly communicated.
rows.whyAiMissed: The AI treated each screen as a static checkpoint and missed cross-page state persistence.
rows.notes: Cart state is lost after page refresh.

rows.item: The first add-to-cart activation changes cart state and gives feedback.
rows.expected: A single click adds the item and produces immediate confirmation.
rows.whyAiMissed: This defect depends on the SUT's unusual first-click behavior and cannot be inferred from a generic checklist.
rows.actual: rows=0, button text="Thêm vào giỏ hàng"
rows.notes: The first activation is ignored and gives no feedback.

rows.item: Adding the same product twice consolidates the row.
rows.expected: One cart row remains and its quantity increases to 2.
rows.whyAiMissed: The AI did not inspect the app-specific CartContext state update strategy.
rows.notes: Adding the same product twice creates duplicate rows.

rows.item: Successful checkout clears the cart.
rows.expected: After a successful checkout, Cart shows the empty state.
rows.whyAiMissed: The AI checked the success message in isolation and missed the downstream cart state.
rows.notes: Successful checkout does not clear the in-memory cart.
